svg.title: Gelephu Mindfulness City Logo - Fully Animatable SVG
svg.desc: Vector recreation from the supplied PNG. No embedded raster. Each emblem region and each wordmark glyph is a separate SVG path for independent animation. Corrected orange curved boundary: solid orange fill with smooth vector curves and no mixed-colour tracing fragments.
svg.metadata: Major groups: background, emblem, emblem-gray, emblem-blue, emblem-coral, emblem-maroon, emblem-orange, emblem-rose, emblem-yellow, wordmark, frame.
